date_note: Date of Mitel advisory MISA-2026-0012 (first issued 16 November 2026; revision 2.0 of 24 November updated the CVE numbers); Italy's CSIRT (ACN) relayed it on 17 November and updated on 20 November.
title: Mitel fixes 5 MiCollab AWV flaws, two critical; Italy's CSIRT relays the advisory
products: MiCollab Audio, Web and Video Conferencing (AWV)
summary: Mitel advisory MISA-2026-0012 (first issued 16 November) fixes 5 flaws in the AWV component of MiCollab release 10.3 (10.3.0.18) and earlier, two rated critical: a command injection and an XML injection. CISA added all five CVEs to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 25 November. Italy's CSIRT (ACN) listed no known exploitation as of its 20 November update.
plain: Mitel fixed five flaws in its MiCollab conferencing software, two of them critical. CISA added all five to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 25 November.
exec: CISA lists all five MiCollab flaws as known exploited (25 November); Italy's CSIRT says exploitation could let an unauthenticated remote attacker run code.
action: Mitel advises applying its patch for release 10.3 (10.3.0.18) per KB000129195 or upgrading, and restricting external access to AWV if it cannot be patched promptly; CISA requires vendor-instructed mitigations and evaluating internet exposure.

recommendations: Apply the patch for release 10.3 (10.3.0.18) per KB000129195, or upgrade to a later release.
If not possible promptly, restrict external access to the AWV component.

validation.note: Mitel advisory MISA-2026-0012 (vendor original, revision 2.0 of 24 November, which lists the five CVE IDs) and the Italy CSIRT (ACN) alert both give five MiCollab AWV flaws, two critical (CVSS 10.0 and 9.0), in 10.3 (10.3.0.18) and earlier, patch per KB000129195. CISA KEV entries (25 November) mark all five as known exploited; ACN listed no known exploitation as of 20 November.

review.note: validation: note was stale (said Mitel lists no CVE IDs, ignored KEV); updated to rev 2.0 and KEV. Title, date, CVSS, patch, mitigation checked against Mitel and ACN

evidence.quote: Mitel provided a patch available for release 10.3 (10.3.0.18) that addresses these vulnerabilities.
